controller_convention.form: parallel PID, I output += ki*e*dt, clipped to raw I_limit; D=kd*(e-e_prev)/dt; output=clip(age_gain*IAS_gain*(P+I+D),-1,1)
controller_convention.inactive_updates: zero command; zero initial memory retained before age gain activates
controller_convention.feedback: previous completed plant acceleration including gravity, projected on current body up/right
controller_convention.gain_and_unit_semantics: assumed mapping, selected on three site fit cases only

loft_field_function.loftElevation: 24: bias aims nose 24 degrees above current world LOS elevation
loft_field_function.loftTargetElevation: -3.5: finish bias when world LOS elevation minus flight-path elevation drops below this angle
loft_field_function.loftAngleToAccelMult: 17.5: scale nose-angle error in degrees to acceleration in m/s^2, times one common fitted scale
loft_field_function.loftTargetOmegaMax: 0.5: eligible only while LOS angular speed in deg/s is at most this value
loft_field_function.phase: initial climb eligible at first active control tick; end once either raw termination threshold fails; no re-arming
loft_field_function.semantics_evidence: game-effect hypotheses using raw fields; internal JARI bias and field units are not exported

runtime_source_boundary.duration: uniform 16 seconds from config; no source terminal time; analysis continues after hypothetical intercept

PID_units.rule: minimum worst initial exported control component error on fit cases, shared across PN candidates

PN.rule: minimum worst early yaw RMSE across 30/60 fit cases; other channels retained separately

request_cap_interpretation.assumed_operation: Euclidean norm clip after complete PN and loft request
request_cap_interpretation.evidence_level: assumed raw-field mapping; not established by JARI exports
request_cap_interpretation.terminal_requested_g: The site's large terminal requested_g is a pre-native diagnostic and neither confirms nor rejects this assumed cap

coefficient_identifiability.nominal_scope: Effective fit in JARI exported control and cross-section coefficient coordinates
coefficient_identifiability.reason: Unknown exported control scale confounds any physical control gain; these coefficients do not identify fin angle or a physical actuator
coefficient_identifiability.loft_scale_classification: bounded calibration, optimum at tested upper bound; not an independently identified field conversion
